actions.message: Big contributions hurt us – keep them tiny

answer.explanation: Resident2 contributed the most (>5) in the last round, so I punish them with the maximum severity my wallet allows, then broadcast a discouraging message.

message.reasoning: We need to act round 3. Check last round contributions: round 2 contributions_by_agent: Resident2 60.5, Resident5 60.5, others 0. Both exceed 5, highest contribution tie 60.5. Choose one with highest, tie any. Pick Resident2 (first). Compute max severity affordable: severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). wallet=30.25, cost 0.3 => floor(30.25/0.3)= floor(100.833)=100. So can punish up to severity 100, but amount field is severity? In action spec punish amount is severity. So amount=100 but cost = severity * punishment_cost =30.0 which is <= wallet. So doable. After punishment, Resident2's wallet reduced by severity (100) floored at zero. No need to track now. Then broadcast discouraging message. Provide actions list two items. Explanation brief.
